whySwitch.title: Why media teams move from Ryze to Cluega AI

items.title: No model lock-in: 400+ models included, never tied to one vendor
items.body: Ryze's MCP route asks you to maintain your own Claude／ChatGPT subscription, hard-wiring model choice to a single vendor. Cluega AI procures and includes 400+ models: Claude for copy, Gemini for analysis, FLUX for images, Veo for video — pick or pin any of them, Auto routing chooses the most cost-effective option, pricier models simply deduct more credits so the structure never works against you, and there's no API key to manage.

items.title: A proprietary data foundation: a dashboard that never sleeps
items.body: The innate limit of conversational AI is "ask once, answer once", with data stranded inside each conversation. Cluega AI's proprietary data foundation streams in all authorised app data — ad accounts, private-domain conversations, sales events, CRM — continuously, and automatically generates a dashboard that updates in real time 24／7: spend anomalies, ROAS swings, creative fatigue all surface before you think to ask. The AI decides on top of it; you supervise on top of it.

items.title: MCP isn't just an entry point, it's a customisable integration layer
items.body: Using MCP to connect an ad account is only step one. Cluega's Enterprise／Agency plans support custom MCP connections — bringing your CRM, databases and internal systems into the same AI workflow and the same data foundation, with multi-tenant architecture letting agencies govern each client in isolation. When the tools connect, the business holds together.

items.title: Attribution is the structural difference
items.body: Ryze's performance tracking stops at GA4 and website conversions; yet a huge share of the world's sales happen in WhatsApp／LINE／Zalo DMs. Cluega's private-domain IM attribution pushes DM sales back to campaign and creative — so every buying decision the AI makes rests on sales data nobody else can see.

ryze.body: You're a solo media buyer or a small team that already has a Claude subscription and wants the cheapest way to let AI connect quickly to Google／Meta accounts for day-to-day audits and optimisation, with no need for private-domain attribution or multi-model workflows yet.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you might want to know before you reach out to our team.

items.q: Does Cluega AI support MCP as well?
items.a: It does. Custom MCP connections are available from the Enterprise plan up, with the Agency plan adding multi-tenant architecture — not just "using MCP to connect an ad account", but bringing your CRM, databases and internal systems into the AI workflow.

items.q: Do we need to bring our own model API keys?
items.a: No. The 400+ models are procured and included by Cluega, with credits deducted back from cost; from Enterprise up, BYO models are also supported for special requirements, and the two modes can coexist.

items.q: How does Auto routing pick a model?
items.a: It selects the most cost-effective model by task type: economical models for high-volume classification, flagship models at the moment of closing, and image or video routed to the matching model as needed. You can also pin a specific model, with fees deducted transparently at that model's cost.

items.q: Does the real-time dashboard need separate setup or payment?
items.a: No. As soon as an app is authorised and connected, its data streams continuously into Cluega's proprietary data foundation, and the dashboard is generated automatically, updates in real time and never sleeps — ad spend, the MMT funnel, creative performance and private-domain sales sit on one panel, and views can be customised per team role.

It's cheap. Ad accounts only need to be authorised through the official APIs, and historical data is folded automatically into AAIGS tier assessment; you can start in self-serve mode ($99／month) to run creative and optimisation, then switch on fully managed account by account once you've validated it.
